mapper.select: WITH TEMP AS ( SELECT * FROM( select sys_data_process_mark.*,rank() over(partition by workflow_id order by HIS_NO desc) as rank from sys_data_process_mark where page_id in ('FinProductFeePay002','FinProductFeePay004','FinproductPayTheVatQuery002','FinProductQuotation002') ) WHERE rank = 1 ) SELECT T.create_user as launchUser, nvl(pp.PORTFOLIO_ID,fp.finprod_market_id) AS portfolioId, nvl(pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME,fp.FINPROD_ABBR) as portfolioName, deal.trade_id tradeId, tdeal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId, decode(deal.trade_amt,'',null,deal.trade_amt) tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL ON deal.workflow_id = T.seq_no and T.PROCESS_STATE != 'END' left join wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total tdeal on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tdeal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = tdeal.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE deal.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' and T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} union select launchUser, portfolioId, portfolioName, tradeId, totleTradeId, decode(tradeAmt,'',null,tradeAmt) tradeAmt, nextUser, createTaskTime, instCode from( SELECT T.create_user as launchUser, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, case when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay002' then temp.business_data_pk3 when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay004' then T.TRADE_ID when temp.page_id = 'FinproductPayTheVatQuery002' then '' else '' end as tradeId, case when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay002' then '' when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay004' then '' when temp.page_id = 'FinproductPayTheVatQuery002' then temp.business_data_pk1 else '' end as totleTradeId, case when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay002' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"actPayAmt":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"actPayAmt":"',''),'"','') when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay004' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"ActPayAmtSum":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"ActPayAmtSum":"',''),'"','') when temp.page_id = 'FinproductPayTheVatQuery002' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"tradeAmt":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"tradeAmt":"',''),'"','') else null end as tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN TEMP on T.seq_no = temp.workflow_id and T.PROCESS_STATE != 'END' LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on (case when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay002' then temp.business_data_pk1 when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay004' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk2,'^F16_','') when temp.page_id = 'FinproductPayTheVatQuery002' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk2,'^F16_','') else regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk1,'^F16_','') end) = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} )
